description: Who's next? Let the wheel decide. Put a wheel on the board, fill it with names, ideas or the people here, and press Spin: everyone on the board watches it turn and land on the same pick, even without Spin. Give each slice an emoji or a photo, take picked names off until you reset, start from warm-up questions in English or Thai, and keep several wheels side by side. Made for standups, workshops, retros and classrooms.
